scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind desktop shortcuts.
File Explorer: helps browse computer files and folders. Navigation pane: lists useful locations.
Search box: helps find a named item. Storage drive: holds saved digital information. Recycle Bin: temporarily holds many deleted files.
With an adult supervising, practise file explorer and navigation pane using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
